additional_concerns: All 12 required pairs are retained. NOT_APPLICABLE addresses only the exact gift questions and does not authorize deleting either duty from a broader compliance model.

The authority disagreement concerns whether independent verification of underlying law is required. NONE_DECLARED is appropriate for these narrow claims expressly stated in the supplied circular. MISSING would apply to independent verification requiring the underlying external provisions; that broader assessment remains unresolved. No external dependency is AVAILABLE.

External texts not supplied include Handbook Overarching Principles section 6.4; Code of Conduct paragraphs 2.3 and 3.11; question 1 of the SFC Code of Conduct FAQs issued on 30 September 2010; and the Advertising Guidelines Applicable to Collective Investment Schemes Authorized under the Product Codes and applicable supplements. Independent assessment of the structured-product restriction would also require SFO section 103 and applicable exemptions. No supplied dependency IDs identify these authorities.

Footnote 1 is supplied in db43e253bea18.u27.7511, so the disclosure claim's missing-footnote annotation is stale. The source additionally requires disclosure that investors may not recover principal; this claim is a partial extraction.

The advertising prohibition concerns the referenced services. The passage also addresses deposit parallels, deposit-like arrangements and comparisons with bank deposit rates. These are separate from gift classification.

Offering and promotional conditions placed in Scope produce OUT_OF_SCOPE when false, rather than a negative prohibition answer or affirmative selected-control compliance answer. Unknown scope can also prevent resolution by a decisive result predicate. Whether these conditions delimit the assessment universe or belong in the substantive result remains unresolved across the candidates.

The offer-level candidates combine an offer-level promotional connection with an existential non-discount gift component. They must establish the relevant connection for that component; otherwise mixed offers could produce unsupported prohibitions. 'Separately identifiable' must not create an exemption for bundled or poorly itemised gifts.

The source regulates distributors who offer gifts. The provider terminology in node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249 must preserve offer attribution rather than identify only a funder or fulfiller. The source does not resolve every agency or third-party attribution question.

Paragraph 9 says returns or incentives may be gifts; automatic classification would add an unsupported restriction. A discount elsewhere in an offer does not exempt a distinct gift component, while absence of a discount alone does not establish a prohibited gift.

The circular's setting concerns SFC-authorised funds, while quoted paragraph 3.11 refers to investment products generally. Fund-specific candidates should not be treated as complete implementations for every investment product without resolving that scope distinction.

TRUE_IS_COMPLIANT is limited to the selected gift control. A negative prohibition result or OUT_OF_SCOPE grants no general permission; disclosure, advertising and section 103 requirements remain independent.

No concrete operative interval or runtime implementation is supplied. These assessments concern the represented expressions and do not verify execution, current-law applicability or competing temporal interpretations.
